text:
alexa_sales: BankCo signed a POC. They want a committed baseline for HIPAA workloads + burst capacity for peak trading windows. Rough traffic profile: steady 2k qps embeddings, chat gen ~1k qps, plus 3x short spikes/day to ~40k qps for 2-4 minutes. Ask: recommended reserved GPU commitment, autoscale/burst policy, preheat/runbook, and any enterprise blockers (security questionnaire items to flag).

sam_se: congrats! quick Q — are the spikes predictable windows (cron-like) or fully random?

alexa_sales: mostly predictable around market opens: 09:55-10:02, 12:30-12:35, 15:50-15:55 (customer timezone). They can give exact cron ranges for POC.

sam_se: OK that's great — predictable spikes make preheat straightforward. For sizing: recommend baseline reserved GPUs sized for steady-state throughput + a dedicated burst pool. Example starting point: baseline = capacity for 3k qps gen-equivalent (safety margin), burst pool = enough GPUs to handle spike concurrency.

matt_eng: rough sizing math I used: one A100-80GB (fp16/quantized) for chat gen ~ 1.5k qps (short sequences, batch-friendly). Embeddings are cheaper — a single T4-ish equivalence can handle ~3k qps. For their mix, baseline reserve = 2 A100-equivalents + 1 T4-equivalent. Burst target to reach 40k qps: need ~20 A100-equivalents for the short window. That's a big delta — we'll rely on quick autoscale + burst credits.

nina_sre: two operational points: 1) preheat KV/prefix cache ahead of the window (15 min prewarm) and 2) autoscale guardrails so spikes don't blow budget. Also need AZ affinity/placement to avoid cross-AZ latency.

jia_solutions: +1 on prewarm. We should stage a cached prompt set they can hit during POC to warm KV. For the POC runbook, propose: preheat at T-15m, spin burst pool at T-5m, enable routing policy to prefer dedicated cluster during spike, fallback to quantized-8bit variant if queue grows > 50ms p99.

matt_eng: adding a sample autoscale policy snippet (for the ops runbook):
```yaml
autoscale:
  baseline_reserved: 2  # A100-equivalents
  burst_pool_max: 22   # A100-equivalents
  preheat_minutes: 15
  prewarm_batching: true
  scale_up_threshold: 0.7  # CPU/GPU util or queue depth ratio
  scale_down_minutes: 10
  fallback_model: "gen-8bit-compact-v1"
  kv_cache_warm_prefixes: ["market_open_prompts_v1"]
```

matt_eng: note these numbers are conservative — we can tune after 1-2 spike rehearsals.

chet_finance: quick on pricing — customers usually prefer either (A) committed GPUs/month with tiered burst credits, or (B) a hybrid: smaller committed baseline + consumption-billed burst. For BankCo I recommend hybrid: commit 2-3 GPUs for baseline and sell a burst-credit bundle sized for expected spike minutes. Finance can map to $/GPU-month + burst credit list.

nina_sre: security blockers: HIPAA requires customer-managed keys for PHI, audit logs retention, VPC peering or private link, and an SSO SAML + SCIM mapping. For POC we can scope minimal PHI (tokenization/stripping) but they asked for end-to-end encryption / KMS — need compliance team signoff.

jia_solutions: we should add a short checklist for the customer questionnaire: KMS ok? Any Egress restrictions? SOC2 docs needed? Any required on-prem timeline?

alexa_sales: they said KMS + SOC2 + monthly access reviews. On-prem not immediate but they want a plan. Good to surface the runbook and pricing options.

matt_eng: ops notes: KV warming approach — generate a small batch of synthetic traffic that hits top 1000 prompts to populate KV. Implementation: use our `preheat-run` lambda that queues warmup requests. Example command: `rdctl preheat --profile market_open_prompts_v1 --duration 900s --concurrency 200`

infra_bot: deploy-bot: reserved-pool "bankco-poc" created (2 A100-equiv baseline, burst: 22 max) by matt_eng at 2024-06-04T15:31:02Z :white_check_mark:

sam_se: next steps I suggest: 1) finalize exact cron windows with customer, 2) agree baseline commit (2 GPUs) + burst credit bundle for POC, 3) run two rehearsal preheats and measure p99 latency and queue depth, 4) collect security answers for KMS/SCIM/SOC2. I'll own runbook and rehearsal.

alexa_sales: I'll send the commit proposal and questionnaire to BankCo today. sam_se can you draft the POC runbook and attach to the proposal?

sam_se: on it. I'll attach the autoscale YAML and a short checklist. Can someone from finance produce a stub pricing estimate for commit 2 GPUs + 60 minutes/day of burst credits for 30 days?

chet_finance: I'll put numbers in a sheet and drop here by EOD. For quick calc: 2 x A100/month prorated for POC + burst credits priced at $X/min per A100-equivalent — will confirm.

nina_sre: tagging security: @matt_eng please also capture how we log KV preheat runs (audit requirement). We need an exportable audit line per preheat event.

matt_eng: will add logging + audit-id to preheat tool.

jia_solutions: I'll prepare the warmup prompt set and a short how-to for the customer to run preheat from their side if they want to trigger it.

alexa_sales: perfect. Thanks team — I'll follow up with BankCo and loop in security for KMS discussion. :thumbsup:

sam_se: leaving this thread for visibility — will post the runbook link once draft is ready.
